scope: Correction to reported completion bound, not a mutation of preregistered inputs, costs, cap, labels or outcomes
cause: The initial offline capture throws before a response and therefore cannot traverse completeJSON's existing exactly-one billed-truncation/invalid-JSON completion retry. The retry keeps the same question/input, doubles only the output ceiling and uses a distinct persistent request key. No accepted or uncertain provider ID is resubmitted. Both the original failed receipt and any retry are charged through the same persistent phase and lifetime guard.
policy: Preserve the original estimate and every input/result. No cap increase and no extra benchmark. An insufficient cap would leave retained pending/error cases in the denominator. The qualified version, if any, must retain this exact bounded transport behavior.
billing_mode: The current qualification runner does not supply flexStages to the transport. Do not assume the planned Flex preference was realized; use the exact served tier and rates from receipts. No native Batch discount is booked.
